name: BikeBridge
tagline: Companion app for e-bikes and components
blurb: BikeBridge is a companion for your e-bike and components, built with privacy in mind.
description:
BikeBridge is a companion for your e-bike and components, built with privacy in mind.

Features

• See statistics (e.g. speed, total distance, gear) in real-time

• See all raw data transmitted/received to/from bike

• Send custom payloads

• Change settings on bike

• See bike info (e.g. serial number, MAC address, etc.)

• HUD

Supported powertrains

• Bosch

• Shimano

• SRAM

See documentation for full feature list at https://bridge.bike

BikeBridge only supports bikes/components that use Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)
